statement: let psi := fun (q a x : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => n%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n; (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, 2 ≤ x → |psi 4 1 x - (x : ℝ)/2| ≤ C * Real.sqrt x * Real.log (8*(x : ℝ))^2
